list.empty_status_desc: Try a different status filter or create a new campaign.

create_modal.intro: Select the type of outbound campaign you want to create. Each type comes with optimized conversation templates and tracking.

general.heading: General
general.subheading: Organization defaults that apply to new agents and calls.

roles.heading: Roles & permissions
roles.footer: Roles are assigned per organization. Contact your owner to change yours. Owner-only actions like billing and user management are intentionally restricted.

security.heading: Security & compliance
security.subheading: How your data is protected and who can access it.
security.footer: Security controls are managed by Replit Voice. To request a SOC 2 report, BAA, or pen-test summary, contact support.

privacy.heading: Privacy & data control
privacy.subheading: Export your organization data or schedule a permanent deletion. Both are GDPR/CCPA compliant.
privacy.export_card_body: Download a ZIP archive with your tenant's calls, agents, knowledge base, integrations, and audit log. The export reflects everything stored about your organization right now.
privacy.export_owner_only: Only the organization owner can export tenant data.
privacy.delete_card_body_prefix: Permanently delete your tenant and all associated data. This is irreversible. The deletion runs after a
privacy.delete_card_body_suffix: — you can cancel any time before then.
privacy.deletion_scheduled_msg: Deletion scheduled. You can cancel any time before the cool-off ends.
privacy.reason_placeholder: Help us understand why you're leaving…
privacy.delete_owner_only: Only the organization owner can request deletion.
privacy.footer_suffix: for details on how your data is protected and what we retain in backups.

notifications.subheading: Mute the categories you don't care about. Defaults are everything on, so changes only suppress the rows you turn off — your teammates' inboxes are unaffected.

connector_alerts.heading: Connector failure alerts
connector_alerts.subheading: Choose how you're warned when an integration goes silent. You can also mute specific providers or single integrations without affecting your teammates.

connector_alerts.load_error: Couldn't load your connector alert preferences.

connector_alerts.mute_alerts_help: Silence both email and in-app failure alerts for an entire provider, or a single connected integration. Recovery and SMS alerts honour the same mute.
connector_alerts.no_connectors: You don't have any connected integrations yet.

csat.heading: Customer satisfaction surveys
csat.subheading: Automatically ask callers to rate their experience after a call. Responses feed your quality dashboard and the cross-tenant CSAT benchmark.
csat.load_error: Failed to load CSAT settings. Please check your connection and try again.
csat.validation_min_duration: Minimum call duration must be between 5 and 600 seconds.
csat.validation_template_length: SMS template must be 320 characters or fewer.
csat.enable_help: When on, qualifying completed calls automatically dispatch a CSAT survey through the channel below. Calls shorter than the minimum duration are skipped.

sms.label: SMS text
sms.helper: Send a short text after the call asking for a rating reply.

web.label: Web link
web.helper: Generate a per-call survey link surfaced via integrations or follow-ups.

email.label: Email
email.helper: Include a survey link in a follow-up email (requires email integration).

csat.scale_help: Scores are normalized internally so you can compare across scales without re-rating prior responses.
csat.min_duration_help: Calls shorter than this won't trigger a survey — avoids surveying hangups and misdials. 5–600 seconds.
csat.template_placeholder: Thanks for calling! How would you rate this call?
csat.template_help_sms: Customize the opening line. The rating prompt and STOP footer are appended automatically.
csat.template_help_other: Only used when the survey channel is SMS.
csat.preview_default_intro: Thanks for calling! How would you rate this call?
csat.preview_suffix: Reply {{range}} (1=poor, {{scale}}=great). Reply STOP to opt out.
csat.owner_only: Contact your organization owner to change CSAT settings.

csat.recent_subheading_one: Most recent 1 customer rating, newest first.
csat.recent_subheading_other: Most recent {{count}} customer ratings, newest first.
